calculation_handling.description: The loading spaces required for a designated heritage site are the lesser of the Clause 220.5.10.1 requirement and the number that existed on July 20, 1993.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built count of loading spaces on that date; the Clause 220.5.10.1 requirement is a cross-reference, not a literal.

calculation_handling.description: Added or replaced floor area on a heritage site must meet the loading requirements of this By-law.

220.20.1(1).explanation: A designated heritage site needs only the lesser of the Clause 220.5.10.1 loading space requirement and the number of loading spaces that existed on July 20, 1993.

220.20.1(2).explanation: Floor area added to or replaced on a heritage site must be given loading spaces in line with this By-law.
